Setting: SSPR Registration Coverage At Least 90 Percent (Among SSPR-Enabled Users)
Recommendation: Drive SSPR registration coverage above 90% among users the tenant allows to use it. Note: whether SSPR should be enabled at all is customer-specific - a fully cloud-native, passwordless-only tenant with no password to reset may not need SSPR in scope; this check only reports registration hygiene among users it is currently enabled for. Time-sensitive: starting 2026-10-05, SSPR will only accept explicitly registered authentication methods - directory-sourced attributes synced from on-premises AD (mobilePhone, businessPhone, otherMails) that were never explicitly registered will stop working for SSPR verification. A hybrid tenant relying on Entra Connect-prepopulated contact info to bootstrap SSPR without requiring registration should treat this coverage number as urgent: users who look fine today via prepopulated data may be unable to reset their password after that date unless they explicitly register before then. An automatic registration-campaign nudge for affected users begins 2026-11-09 - note this is AFTER the 2026-10-05 date above, not ahead of it; re-verify both dates against the Source URL, as Microsoft has already moved them once (originally 2026-09-07 and 2026-08-06 respectively). See https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/authentication/howto-sspr-authenticationdata.
